name: chainskills
description: Stack-agnostic skills for any blockchain project, new or existing, that can extend themselves: design, specs, consensus, staking, rollups, randomness, verifiable participation, tokenomics, governance, smart contracts, stack adapters (Cosmos SDK, EVM L1, OP Stack, Arbitrum chains, ZK Stack, Polkadot SDK, Avalanche L1, Solana/SVM, Move, custom CometBFT/Malachite, Hyperledger Fabric, plus on-the-fly adapters for any other stack), security, testing and formal verification.
